metadata.description: Agent plugins by Jim Cline — role hierarchies, context-window discipline, compaction, and pull-request tooling.

plugins.name: ah
plugins.description: Multi-agent role hierarchy, each on the right model. Optional herdr transport for pane-based teams.

plugins.name: comment-discipline
plugins.description: Blocks comments that only make sense next to the diff.

plugins.name: output-discipline
plugins.description: Keeps command output from flooding the context window.

plugins.name: review-guide
plugins.description: Note-as-you-go PR walkthroughs: a ledger, a CLI, and a skill. Nothing is enforced.

plugins.name: task-gopher
plugins.description: Delegates tool-heavy work to a cheap Haiku runner.

plugins.name: github-pr-toolkit
plugins.description: Pull-request toolkit — /resolve-pr-comments resolves the review threads reviewers opened; /code-critic authors an adversarial review of a local diff or a GitHub PR. A high-reasoning orchestrator delegates all GitHub and outbound-git work to Haiku workers over GitHub's hosted MCP server; one PAT config covers both commands. Replaces the former resolve-pr-comments and code-critic plugins.

plugins.name: idle-compactor
plugins.description: Runs /compact automatically when a session goes idle, timed to land just before the Anthropic prompt cache expires — or, in keepalive mode, pings the cache instead of compacting.

plugins.name: compaction-capture
plugins.description: Saves each compaction summary to a file after compaction completes, so the context a session dropped is still on disk.

plugins.name: compaction-guard
plugins.description: Re-states your standing directives after every compaction, so rules the summary dropped are back in context before the next turn.
